title: coelogyne propinqua
intro: Coelogyne propinqua, commonly known as the Slipper Orchid, is a species of orchid native to tropical Asia. This plant is traditionally used in medicine and has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Coelogyne propinqua include antioxidant and antiseptic activities, which can aid in wound healing and protect against oxidative stress. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
